description: Native plugin compilation — unrecognized scenario handling. The native_plugins stage is the only stage that branches on a `scenario` selector (static_lib, shared_lib, resources, user_libraries). When the adapter receives a native_plugins command whose scenario is not one of these (including the implicit `default` scenario used when the field is omitted), the stage rejects it with a normalized `error=unknown_scenario` line that echoes the offending scenario name, rather than running an arbitrary build. These synthetic cases cover the default/omitted scenario and an arbitrary unknown scenario, which the native feature suite never exercises.
